title: Terminal Mux: Core SessionManager, VirtualTerminal, PTY, events
description:
Implement terminal mux core from docs/plans/09-h2-termmux-port.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (SessionManager), §4.1 (VirtualTerminal), §4.2 (PTY management), §4.3 (multi-client attach/detach), §5 (event normalization — three-source handler)

Key deliverables:
- SessionManager: Create/Get/List/Kill sessions, capacity limits, graceful shutdown
- VirtualTerminal: PTY wrapper, read/write, resize, environment setup
- PTY management: allocate/deallocate, signal forwarding, hung child detection (no response to SIGTERM within timeout → SIGKILL)
- Multi-client attach/detach: fan-out writes to all attached clients, client disconnect cleanup
- Panic recovery: per-session goroutine recovery, session marked as crashed but manager continues
- Three-source event normalization: OTEL server events, hook events, session log JSONL events → unified AgentEvent stream
- Event types: session lifecycle, agent state changes, tool calls, streaming content
- Unit tests for SessionManager, VirtualTerminal, PTY lifecycle, event normalization

See Implementation Guide §1.4: AgentDriver contract — all drivers emit canonical AgentEvent types. Subscribe callbacks isolated from panics.
